title: Her parents sold curtains from a market stall in Leicester. In 2026, their daughter became Britain's Ambassador to the Vatican.

sources.text: Eastern Eye - Tammy Sandhu's historic Vatican ambassador role
Catholic Connect - Tammy Sandhu becomes first woman from ethnic minority background to serve as British Ambassador to Holy See

caption:
Her parents sold curtains from a market stall in Leicester. In 2026, their daughter became Britain's Ambassador to the Vatican.

She became the first woman from an ethnic minority background - and the first woman of Indian origin - to hold the post, confirmed by an official Vatican Press Office record of the credentials ceremony.

Her parents worked market stalls selling household goods before starting a family business. She went on to serve as HM Consul General in San Francisco and in postings including Chennai, Rabat and Brussels.

Sandhu's own words capture it best: "I only wish my parents were able to see where I am today."
